text:
Brightly arrayed, a gallant knight

traveled long in sun and in shadow,

singing his song, in search of Eldorado.


--


But he grew old, the spirited knight, and

night fell upon his heart because nowhere

did he find the land of Eldorado.


--


And at last, when his strength failed him, he could

find a pilgrim shadow. "Shadow," he

asked, "where might that land of

Eldorado be?"


--


"Beyond the mountains of the Moon, in

the depth of the valley of shadows; ride,

ride without rest," answered the shadow, "if

you seek Eldorado..."

translation.title: Eldorado
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the Spanish catalog's prose-line form while preserving the quest refrain.
